NNEW CONCEPT ENGLISHBOOK 01 / 新概念英语

BOOK ONE · LESSON 132

He may be... He may have been... 他可能是…… 他可能已经……

他可能是…… 他可能已经……

A picture lesson on possibility: 'may be/do' (present or future possibility), 'may have been/done' (past possibility), and 'I'm not sure'. Six pictures show someone guessing where Harry is, where he will go, why he is late, what he is doing, why he was late and what he was doing. The lesson introduces written exercises on answering questions about the Lesson 131 conversation, and answering 'Do you think ...?' questions with 'I'm not sure. She may (have) been ...'. The workbook drills rewriting answers with 'may' and answering personal questions; the grammar workbook writes sentences with 'may' and 'may have ...' according to examples.

01

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Listen to the tape and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

听录音并回答问题。

1. Where's Harry? He may be in his room. I'm not sure.
2. Where will he go? He may go to the cinema. I'm not sure.
3. Why is he late? He may be busy. I'm not sure.
4. What is he doing? He may be reading. I'm not sure.
5. Why was he late? He may have been busy. I'm not sure.
6. What was he doing? He may have been reading. I'm not sure.

1. 哈里在哪里？他可能在他的房间里。我不敢肯定。
2. 他要去哪里？他可能去看电影。我不敢肯定。
3. 他为什么迟到了？他可能很忙。我不敢肯定。
4. 他在做什么？他可能在看书。我不敢肯定。
5. 他为什么迟到了？他当时可能很忙。我不敢肯定。
6. 他当时在做什么？他当时可能在看书。我不敢肯定。

Listen and answer the questions

Listen to the tape and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

听录音并回答问题。

Written A: Answer the questions

Read the conversation in Lesson 131 again. Then answer these questions. 重读第 131 课的对话，然后回答以下问题。

重读第 131 课的对话，然后回答以下问题。

7 comprehension questions about the Lesson 131 conversation (Martin and Gary).

Written B: Answer the questions

Answer these questions. 模仿例句回答以下问题。

模仿例句回答以下问题。

20 'Do you think ...?' rewrite items; 2 printed examples on the page (Do you think she is Danish? (Swedish) → I'm not sure. She may be Swedish. / Do you think she was Danish? (Swedish) → I'm not sure. She may have been Swedish.).

MAKE IT YOUR OWN

Practice 练习

Practice A: May be and may have been

Rewrite the answers in these dialogues using may (may be, may do, may have been, may be doing, may have been doing). 用 may 和相关的动词改写以下句子。

用 may 和相关的动词改写以下句子。

7 dialogue-rewrite items; item 1 (Was he right, do you think? → I'm not sure. He may have been right.) is the printed example.

Practice B: About you

Answer these questions about yourself with full sentences. 根据你自己的情况用完整的句子回答以下问题。

根据你自己的情况用完整的句子回答以下问题。

03

BUILD YOUR FOUNDATION

Grammar 语法练习

Grammar I: Write sentences using 'may'

仿照例句用 may 造句。

仿照例句用 may 造句。

10 sentence items; item 1 (You'd better go to bed early. (feel better/in the morning) → You may feel better in the morning.) is the printed example.

Grammar II: Write sentences using 'may have ...'

仿照例句用 may have ... 造句。

仿照例句用 may have ... 造句。

10 sentence items; item 1 (We'd better hurry. (the film/already started) → The film may have already started.) is the printed example.
